faqs.subtitle: Questions
faqs.title: OFW Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.faq1Question: How do I apply for overseas jobs on Trabz?
faqs.faq1Answer: Simply create an OFW profile, upload your documents, and browse DMW-verified job listings. Our smart engine will match you with the right opportunities based on your skills and preferred destination.
faqs.faq2Question: Is the Smart Contract Scanner safe?
faqs.faq2Answer: Yes, the Smart Contract Scanner uses advanced algorithms to analyze employment contracts. We do not save your contracts — everything is encrypted and deleted after scanning. We only provide highlights and warnings.
faqs.faq3Question: How do I use the Remittance Tracker?
faqs.faq3Answer: Just connect your GCash or Maya account, and all your remittances will be tracked automatically. You can also set remittance schedules and notify your family when a transfer has been sent.
faqs.faq4Answer: The basic OFW features are free — job search, document storage, and the SOS hotline. Premium features like the Smart Contract Scanner and advanced remittance tools are included in the paid plan.
faqs.faq5Question: How do I contact the SOS Hotline?
faqs.faq5Answer: Just tap the SOS button in the app and you'll be automatically connected to the nearest Philippine embassy or consulate. Available 24/7 in all countries with an OFW presence.

hero.subtitle: KayaScore Assessment
hero.title: The Right Person in the Right Seat
hero.description: Smart job-fit assessment that helps employers find the best-matched candidates — and workers find jobs that truly fit them.

howItWorks.subtitle: How It Works
howItWorks.title: Three Simple Steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: A 15-minute online assessment that measures your skills, personality, and work preferences. No right or wrong answers.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our smart engine analyzes your responses and creates a comprehensive job-fit profile.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Employers and workers receive a compatibility score. The higher the score, the better the job fit.

features.subtitle: Features
features.title: Why KayaScore?
features.description: Not just a simple test — but a complete assessment platform powered by smart technology for smarter hiring decisions.
features.feature1Desc: Comprehensive assessment of technical and soft skills. Based on TESDA National Competency standards.
features.feature2Desc: Smart algorithm that analyzes thousands of data points for the most accurate job-fit score.
features.feature3Desc: Predictive analytics that forecasts how successful a candidate will be in a role based on assessment results.
features.feature4Desc: Not just skills — also measures work values, team dynamics, and cultural compatibility.
features.feature5Desc: Assessment aligned with TESDA National Competency standards for blue-collar and technical roles.
features.feature6Desc: Data-driven and objective scoring. No bias on age, gender, or background. Fair for everyone.
features.feature7Desc: 21-trait assessment across 5 domains: Work Ethic, Safety, Interpersonal, Adaptability, and Motivation.
features.feature8Desc: Role-specific scenario questions for 9 job categories from construction to caregiving.
features.feature9Desc: 6 dark personality traits screening for safety-critical roles like drivers and caregivers.
features.feature10Desc: Weighted scoring: 40% behavioral, 35% situational judgment, 25% dark trait screen.
features.feature11Desc: Ideal trait profiles per job category based on top performer data.

faqs.subtitle: Questions
faqs.title: KayaScore FAQ
faqs.faq1Answer: Yes, the assessment is free for all workers. For employers, unlimited assessments are included in the Business and Enterprise plans.
faqs.faq2Question: How long does the assessment take?
faqs.faq2Answer: About 15 minutes. Can be completed on phone or computer. No time pressure — go at your own pace.
faqs.faq3Question: How is the job-fit score calculated?
faqs.faq3Answer: Our smart engine analyzes skills, personality traits, work preferences, and cultural values. It compares these against job requirements to produce a compatibility percentage.
faqs.faq4Answer: Yes, you can retake after 30 days. Your results improve as you acquire new skills and experience.
faqs.faq5Answer: Yes. All assessment data is encrypted. We never share raw data with employers — they only see the compatibility score and summary.

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use the Platform. By registering, you represent and warrant that you meet this age requirement and have the legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement.

Employer accounts must be created by an authorized representative of the company or organization.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content:
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to notify Trabz immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

You may not share your account with others or create multiple accounts. Trabz reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

conduct.title: User Conduct
conduct.content:
You agree not to:

- Post false, misleading, or fraudulent job listings or profile information
- Harass, threaten, or discriminate against other users
- Use the Platform for any illegal purpose
- Attempt to access other users' accounts or data
- Scrape, crawl, or otherwise extract data from the Platform without authorization
- Circumvent any security measures or access controls

content.title: Content and Intellectual Property
content.content:
You retain ownership of content you submit to the Platform (profile information, job posts, messages). By submitting content, you grant Trabz a non-exclusive, worldwide license to use, display, and distribute your content in connection with the Platform.

The Trabz name, logo, and all related marks are trademarks of Trabz Technologies Inc. You may not use them without prior written permission.

payments.title: Payments and Fees
payments.content:
Job searching and basic features are free for workers. Employer subscriptions and premium features are subject to the pricing listed on the Platform.

All payments are processed through our authorized payment partners (GCash, Maya, credit/debit cards). Trabz does not store your full payment card information.

Refunds are processed in accordance with our refund policy. Subscription fees are non-refundable once the billing period has begun.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content:
You may delete your account at any time through the app settings. Trabz may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms.

Upon termination, your right to use the Platform ceases immediately. Trabz may retain certain data as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.content:
The Platform is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. Trabz does not guarantee employment outcomes, the accuracy of job listings, or the conduct of other users.

Trabz is a platform that connects workers and employers. We are not an employer, staffing agency, or recruitment firm. Employment relationships are between the worker and the employer.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content:
To the maximum extent permitted by Philippine law, Trabz shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Platform.

Trabz's total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid to Trabz in the 12 months preceding the claim.

governing.title: Governing Law
governing.content: These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Makati City, Metro Manila.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: Trabz reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will notify users of material changes via email or in-app notification. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy describes how Trabz collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content:
We collect the following types of personal information:

Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, password, and profile photo.

Profile Information: Skills, work experience, location, job preferences, and uploaded documents (ID, certifications).

Usage Data: Device information, IP address, app usage patterns, and interaction data.

Location Data: GPS location (with your consent) for job matching and shift check-in/out.

Payment Data: Transaction history and payment method details (processed by our payment partners).

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content:
We use your personal information to:

- Provide and improve the Platform's features and services
- Match workers with relevant job opportunities
- Process payments and financial transactions
- Send notifications about job matches, application updates, and platform updates
- Verify user identities and prevent fraud
- Comply with legal obligations
- Generate anonymized analytics to improve our services

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.content:
We share your information with:

Employers: Your profile information is visible to employers when you apply for jobs.

Service Providers: Payment processors, cloud hosting, and analytics services that help operate the Platform.

Legal Requirements: When required by law, court order, or government regulation.

We never sell your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

storage.title: Data Storage and Security
storage.content:
Your data is stored on secure servers with industry-standard encryption. We use SSL/TLS for data in transit and AES-256 encryption for data at rest.

We retain your data for as long as your account is active. After account deletion, we may retain certain data for up to 5 years as required by Philippine law.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content:
Under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173), you have the right to:

- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data (subject to legal requirements)
- Object to data processing
- Data portability
- File a complaint with the National Privacy Commission (NPC)

To exercise these rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@trabz.ph.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content:
Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content.

You can control cookie settings through your browser. Disabling cookies may affect some Platform features.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: The Platform is not intended for users under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we discover that we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it promptly.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes through the app or via email. Your continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance.

contactSection.content:

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.description: How Trabz protects your personal data in compliance with Philippine law.

framework.title: Legal Framework
framework.content: Trabz Technologies Inc. complies with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173) and its Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR). We are registered with the National Privacy Commission (NPC) as a Personal Information Controller (PIC).

principles.title: Data Protection Principles
principles.content:
We adhere to the following principles:

Transparency: We inform you about how your data is collected and used.

Legitimate Purpose: Data is collected only for declared, specified, and legitimate purposes.

Proportionality: We collect only the data that is necessary and relevant to our services.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful Basis for Processing
lawfulBasis.content:
We process your personal data based on:

Consent: You provide consent when creating your account and agreeing to our Terms.

Contractual Necessity: Processing required to provide our services to you.

Legal Obligation: Processing required to comply with Philippine laws and regulations.

Legitimate Interest: Processing necessary for our legitimate business purposes, balanced against your rights.

measures.title: Security Measures
measures.content:
We implement the following security measures:

- End-to-end encryption for sensitive data
- Regular security audits and penetration testing
- Access controls and authentication mechanisms
- Employee training on data protection
- Incident response procedures
- Secure backup and disaster recovery systems

breach.title: Data Breach Response
breach.content:
In the event of a personal data breach, we will:

- Notify the National Privacy Commission within 72 hours
- Notify affected data subjects if the breach poses a real risk of serious harm
- Document the breach and corrective actions taken
- Implement measures to prevent recurrence

transfers.title: Cross-Border Data Transfers
transfers.content: Your data may be processed in servers located outside the Philippines for cloud hosting and service delivery. We ensure that any cross-border transfer complies with the Data Privacy Act and that adequate safeguards are in place to protect your data.
